subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-facing payload format should Feishu card actions use when callbacks include form_value, input_value, name, option, or options?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but prior linked PRs disagree on whether to pass a structured JSON payload or append values into command text, and that affects downstream agent/plugin expectations.

options.title: Structured JSON payload
options.body: Pass action.value together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button behavior.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Append form/select fields into the existing command text path, minimizing handler changes but making complex values harder to parse reliably.

options.title: Pause until PR refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the linked PR to be rebased with real Feishu proof before choosing the permanent format.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON payload
recommendation.body: Pass action.value together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman is the strongest available owner signal for the structured card-action design because they authored the current structured interaction flow and merged the original callback handler.
